validation.bundle_build: Passed with native csc warnings as errors and embedded-manifest verification
validation.archive: Every ZIP entry and manifest byte verified
validation.unchanged_runtime: C# source is unchanged since bundle18 safety and launcher recovery checks. The WindowsBackgroundApp installation-name guard changed; full npm check passed with 1470 tests and zero skipped, including compiled Rust broker integration. Final test-only path portability edits passed on both Linux and Windows. Rust, dependency and shared contract source remain unchanged; preceding required native/Rust checks are retained.
validation.source_parity: Exact file sets and bytes match the checkout for all 79 runtime/schema/UI source files in the bundle; compiled Windows source matches the staged build input.

retained_failures: Bundle17 installed acceptance exited 1 repairing the damaged fixed bootstrap when three native acceptance processes ran concurrently. The old installer suppressed its exception. Two isolated diagnostic repetitions of all four corruption repairs then passed; the original cause remains unconfirmed, not attributed to timeout as fact.

A longer isolated installation reproduced success from installation followed by failed launch: final version paths exceeded legacy .NET path lengths although shorter staging paths had verified. All file hashes were intact. Bundle18 uses a versioned short copy ID plus separate full SHA-256 bindings, preflights path lengths and verifies final paths before selecting them.
Trusted in-process verification replaces the 30-second child-verifier dependency; changed/unknown bytes remain rejected. No Windows long-path settings were changed.

Independent CRA found that WindowsBackgroundApp still accepted only the old 64-character version names, hiding Settings startup controls for v2 installs. The guard now supports all three layouts. Positive/negative tests passed on Linux and Windows; final native install and v1-to-v2 upgrade checks use the actual Settings adapter to enable, inspect and disable the unique test registration.
limitations: Current Windows 11 x64 host, not a clean independent machine or actual Windows-login run
